K1.text: No sessions or accounts; single-user local tool with no auth system.

K2.text: No users or privileged roles exist.

K3.text: None of the 10 /api routes has an auth check; SEC-01 (fixed, loopback bind) and SEC-02 (fixed 3c84761, cross-site/Origin/Host 403 middleware) keep the LAN and other web pages out, but any local process can still reach GET /api/skills/run and /api/agents/run, and the optional token check was deliberately not done.

K4.text: No tenants or owners; note /api/agents/run does not check projectPath against configured paths and /api/sessions/:slug/:sessionId joins unvalidated slug/sessionId into a path (.jsonl only), both only reachable from the local user.

K5.text: No public unauthenticated write surface; loopback-only.

K7.text: Local loopback tool, no security headers set and none required by its trusted-machine model (cross-site refusal is done by header check in the /api middleware).

K8.text: Spawned claude process still inherits full process.env (every shell secret) with a caller-supplied prompt; no tracked secrets, no VITE/NEXT_PUBLIC vars, config.json and .env* are gitignored.

K10.text: Only log is the startup line and no tokens or bodies are logged; catch blocks return raw err.message to the loopback-only client, acceptable for this tool.

K11.text: Only env var is PORT with inline default; no .env files, nothing to validate.

K12.text: No database; a node --test suite now exists (cross-site test) but there is nothing to point at a DB.

K13.text: No privileged changes to audit; single user.

K14.text: Own fixed port 4173 in config default matching the port table and bound to 127.0.0.1; no Vercel deploy so ignoreCommand and cron routes do not apply (HEAD 3c84761, 2026-11-10).
